items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: the bass player was Johnny Lindsay. Oh, yeah. He used to be an extramo player from there. Uh, so that stayed up for a while

ctx.x: Yeah, did it have a name, the trio?

Yeah, I said, I'm thinking, say, how we got the name, so when we got that, it wouldn't want to ask us for a name, so we started calling us Jump This and something like that, and, uh, so, uh, the place was named the Bar of Music. They always started calling it Chocolate, something like that, so the woman said, she didn't like that, she said, well, I'm going to put two names together, I'm going to use the Chocolate Bar of Music. So, uh, that's how we got, uh, then we stayed there and made a pretty good, you know,…
